shortDescription: Manages servers on the cloudscale.ch IaaS service

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for calls to the cloudscale.ch API. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_TIMEOUT) environment variable.

options.name: api_token
options.description: cloudscale.ch API token. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_TOKEN) environment variable.

options.name: api_url
options.description: cloudscale.ch API URL. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_URL) environment variable.

options.name: bulk_volume_size_gb
options.description: Size of the bulk storage volume in GB. No bulk storage volume if not set.

options.name: flavor
options.description: Flavor of the server.

options.name: force
options.description: Allow to stop the running server for updating if necessary.

options.name: image
options.description: Image used to create the server.

options.name: interfaces
options.description: List of network interface objects specifying the interfaces to be attached to the server. See U(https://www.cloudscale.ch/en/api/v1/#interfaces-attribute-specification) for more details.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the Server. Either I(name) or I(uuid) are required.

options.name: password
options.description: Password for the server.

options.name: server_groups
options.description: List of UUID or names of server groups.

options.name: ssh_keys
options.description: List of SSH public keys. Use the full content of your .pub file here.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the server.

options.name: tags
options.description: Tags assosiated with the servers. Set this to C({}) to clear any tags.

options.name: use_ipv6
options.description: Enable IPv6 on the public network interface.

options.name: use_private_network
options.description: Attach a private network interface to the server.

options.name: use_public_network
options.description: Attach a public network interface to the server.

options.name: user_data
options.description: Cloud-init configuration (cloud-config) data to use for the server.

options.name: uuid
options.description: UUID of the server. Either I(name) or I(uuid) are required.

options.name: volume_size_gb
options.description: Initial size of the root volume in GB. This parameter has no effect on existing servers. Use the volume module to change the size of the root volume.

options.name: zone
options.description: Zone in which the server resides (e.g. C(lpg1) or C(rma1)).
